name: Microraptor (Gui)
label: Gui subspecies
title: Wipfelstürmer
note: Born in Redwoods, Hollow Hills, Wollemi Forest, East Passage, Twisted Forest and Cedrus Forest; more stamina when climbing trees high distances. The subspecies is optional and only says where an individual hatched, so its range overlaps the others'. Shares the official Microraptor profile with the Hanqiugi and Zhaoianus subspecies.
